tools.name: Power BI
tools.intro: Power BI is Microsoft's cloud-based Business Intelligence (BI) and analytics platform that enables organisations to connect to multiple data sources, transform data, build interactive dashboards, and share actionable insights across the enterprise. It integrates seamlessly with the Microsoft ecosystem, including Microsoft Fabric, Azure, Excel, Teams, and Microsoft 365.
tools.bestSuited: Power BI is best suited for enterprise BI, self-service analytics, operational dashboards, and AI-powered reporting within the Microsoft ecosystem.
typicalFeatures: Connects to 100+ cloud and on-premises data sources
Interactive dashboards, reports, and KPI scorecards
Powerful data transformation using Power Query
Semantic data modelling with DAX
Scheduled data refresh, row-level security (RLS), and governance
Mobile access and report sharing across teams
uniqueFeatures: Deep integration with Microsoft Fabric, Azure, Excel, Teams, and Microsoft 365
Copilot-powered report creation and natural language querying (with supported Fabric capacities)
Industry-leading semantic modelling using DAX and reusable datasets
AI visuals such as Key Influencers, Decomposition Tree, Smart Narratives, and anomaly detection
Enterprise-grade security with Microsoft Entra ID integration

tools.name: Tableau

tools.name: ThoughtSpot
tools.intro: ThoughtSpot is a cloud-native Business Intelligence (BI) and analytics platform that enables organisations to explore data using natural language search and AI-driven insights. Built for self-service analytics, it connects directly to modern cloud data platforms, allowing business users to uncover insights quickly without relying heavily on technical teams.

tools.name: Looker

tools.name: Qlik
tools.intro: Qlik is an AI-powered Business Intelligence (BI) and analytics platform that enables organisations to integrate, analyse, and visualise data from multiple sources. Built on its Associative Analytics Engine, Qlik empowers users to freely explore relationships across data while leveraging AI-driven insights, automation, and enterprise-grade governance. It integrates with major cloud platforms, databases, SaaS applications, and Qlik Talend Cloud to support modern analytics workflows.
